notes: cold_start_ms is recorded but deliberately NOT gated: it has no tolerance, which check_regressions reads as ungated. On the hosted macOS runner one run spread Codename One's start-up from 465 to 2588 ms at a host load of 12-32, so any band wide enough not to fire on that noise would catch nothing. Sizes and memory at rest (101.3-111.3 MB in the same run) are stable and gated.
